verdict: Antigravity is directionally right on scope discipline, identity surgery, physical-device gates and Golden Five focus, but overstates current readiness and introduces some unsupported precision.

agree.claim: Scope compression was the major product-management risk.
agree.why: The repository contains launch, future rooms, Next100, partner concepts, WebXR/trading/multiplayer ideas and legacy museum systems. M2 correctly separated launch from platform ambition.

agree.claim: English-only launch is the credible choice.
agree.why: pt-BR exists as policy/locale metadata but primary runtime copy is not comprehensively locale-driven.

agree.claim: Commercial capability must be separated from signed partnerships.
agree.why: This prevents false sponsor/official-status claims and keeps partner architecture reusable.

agree.claim: Founding 141 should mix 3D, editorial, photographic and environmental representations.
agree.why: Forcing every artifact into bespoke 3D increases cost and can reduce authenticity.

agree.claim: M3 requires surgical identity convergence, not global replacement.
agree.why: Kona is also a place/race domain term; Canyon/Speedmax are real provenance; storage keys are compatibility surfaces.

agree.claim: Golden Five are the right visual QA focus.
agree.why: They cover the critical consumer grammar without triggering a broad redesign.

agree.claim: Physical-device background/return, DPR/thermal, touch and cache behavior need explicit testing.
agree.why: Headless viewport tests cannot certify Safari/PWA lifecycle, WebGL context recovery or thermal behavior.

disagree_or_qualify.why: Known debt remains: large landing.js, parallel progression/passport semantics, hall-mobile cascade debt, several renderer lifecycle generations, legacy generated/source coupling.

disagree_or_qualify.claim: The 28-room world and 141 taxonomy are sealed.
disagree_or_qualify.why: Their data invariants are validated, but content/provenance/production representation and runtime wiring are not fully launch-complete.

disagree_or_qualify.claim: Golden Five share the exact same border radiuses and glass blur.
disagree_or_qualify.why: Kona.m intentionally uses artifact-specific shape grammar. Consistency should come from typography, semantic tokens, spacing, hierarchy and interaction, not identical card radii/glass everywhere.
The product plan says onboarding must be optional and skippable. A fixed question count/time target can encourage coercive onboarding. Measure time-to-value and blocker rate instead.
Use the canonical touch-target token and physical-device evidence; CSS px and iOS points are not interchangeable.
It can bias toward decorative polish over clarity, accessibility, provenance and performance. The canonical product principle remains calm surface, deep world underneath.

critical_new_findings.finding: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical/OG/LLM links still point to https://joaoccaldas.github.io/canyonmuseum/.
critical_new_findings.why: M1 deliberately preserved current public origin until deployment is chosen. Once Kona.m uses a new public URL, these must switch atomically with redirects/compatibility.

critical_new_findings.finding: No dedicated SEO/LLM source contract exists; harden_pages.mjs is the de facto authority.
critical_new_findings.why: That is workable but should be documented and tested before changing origin.

critical_new_findings.finding: No analytics/telemetry runtime or analytics documentation exists.
critical_new_findings.why: This is consistent with privacy claims but means WARI, funnel conversion and launch learning cannot currently be measured automatically. Add privacy-preserving first-party event measurement only if it can be done without delaying launch.

critical_new_findings.finding: llms.txt and llms-full.txt are substantive, sourced and generated, but still use the Canyon Museum origin.
critical_new_findings.why: Content quality is already unusually strong; origin convergence is the main launch task.

critical_new_findings.finding: index.html already has canonical, OG/Twitter metadata, JSON-LD, robots indexing and LLM alternate link.
critical_new_findings.why: Do not rebuild SEO architecture; centralize origin and verify generated consistency.

critical_new_findings.finding: Best renderer patterns exist but are inconsistent across older surfaces.
critical_new_findings.why: Do not rewrite before launch; enforce lifecycle/performance contract for new work and converge after launch.

next_order: Finish M3 exact-SHA gates and merge only if green.
Run Golden Five visual/interaction audit against M2 before-state; fix only measured launch defects.
Execute physical Android/iPhone gate and record unresolved limitations honestly.
Prove guest→optional-auth state continuity and offline/PWA update behavior.
Choose canonical production URL/host; then perform one atomic origin/SEO/LLM migration with redirects.
Add minimal privacy-preserving launch event schema and measurement plan; do not add third-party tracking by default.
Run deployment + rollback proof on one exact SHA.
After launch, consolidate progression/state, CSS ownership and renderer lifecycle one bounded subsystem at a time.
